ops.insert: Objective: Provide investors with a clear, current, and well-organized view of the company’s business, performance, plans, and risks.
Confirm that every document is current and approved for external sharing.
Remove or restrict access to personal, sensitive, or legally privileged information.
Add a contact person for questions about each section.
Create a secure data room with role-based access #operations
Set access permissions for each investor or diligence team
Confirm document naming and version-control conventions
Add the date and owner to each major document
Create an index of all shared materials
Review access logs and remove access when appropriate
Establish a process for handling investor questions
Confirm whether downloads, printing, or forwarding are restricted
